arms.label: CO2 Laser +OCT
arms.description: Postmenopausal women with genitourinary syndrome of menopause who will receive CO2 vaginal laser treatment

arms.label: OCT only
arms.description: Premenopausal, peri-menopausal and postmenopausal women who will only get one time OCT scan

eligibility.text:
Inclusion criteria

Aim 1:

. Women who are premenopausal, peri-menopausal and postmenopausal

Aim 2:

. Postmenopausal women with genitourinary syndrome of menopause

Exclusion criteria

* history of pelvic irradiation
* Current pregnant or breastfeeding
* Use of hormone replacement therapy within three months of study enrollment
* Inability to read and understand english
* inability to follow research instructions
